headlines.text: That Friday in 2022, Jay White announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Trent Beretta, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.63 ? a match that delivered. White's in-ring AEW debut, defeating a familiar interpromotional rival in Trent Beretta with the Blade Runner ? the first sign of what would become a much bigger AEW run for the former Bullet Club leader.
